purpose: Machine-readable W10 tranche closure state. Consumed by tests/test_l_series_prerequisite_lock.py which fails if any L-series file exists while any W10 tranche is not closed. Update ONLY as part of the commit that closes each tranche.

W10-1.summary: Real tokenizer and corpus training path in the GUI worker

W10-2.summary: Protected checkpoint integration in the GUI worker

W10-4.summary: Atomic per-generation checkpoint chain with COMPLETE marker

W10-5.summary: Frozen release provenance via embedded RELEASE_METADATA

W10-6.summary: Full-bundle runtime integrity with trusted root

W10-7.summary: Inno paths + payload verification + worker-safe upgrades

W10-9.summary: Real Validate / Diagnose / Recovery / first-run + real metrics

W10-10.summary: Fully-pinned deps + real licenses + attestation handling

W10-11.summary: End-to-end certification against a real English fixture

l_series_gate.unlocks_when: every tranche in .tranches is closed=true (W10-0.1 counts too, though it is only the governance commit)
l_series_gate.reason: L-series measurements against a worker that trains on torch.randint synthetic tokens would produce mutual-information and Bayes-factor readings on noise. Every subsequent claim inherits the contamination. See docs/directives/L_SERIES_LATENT_BYPASS_AND_HIDDEN_STATE_EFFICIENCY_UPGRADE.md §1.
